name: Scenario: menu pass
description: In a level, opens and closes the pause menu with simulated input, opens UnityModManager's window and draws each chosen mod's settings, takes a screenshot with the window open, closes it, returns to the main menu through the pause menu and loads the level again. Runs on its own: the main-menu trip resets player state.

campaign.description: Campaign index, as go_to_level takes it

mod.description: UnityModManager mod id whose settings are drawn, or * for every active mod with settings

frames.description: Frames each mod's settings must draw
